title: Matrixyl 3000 Pro-Collagen Firming Cream

seo.title: Matrixyl 3000 Pro-Collagen Firming Cream | Skingenetix
seo.description: Firming cream with collagen, elastin and Matrixyl 3000 for firmer, plumper-looking skin and rich hydration. Ideal for mature or drier skin. Layers under SPF.

description_html:
A firming cream with a triple collagen complex and Matrixyl 3000 peptides for smoother, plumper, firmer-looking skin.

  • Triple Collagen Complex + Matrixyl 3000 - collagen proteins and matrikine peptides
  • Supports firmer, plumper, more supple-looking skin
  • No parabens · no mineral oil · no synthetic fragrance

Best for: mature or drier skin that wants firmer, plumper-looking skin and rich, comforting hydration.

Size: 50ml
custom.key_benefits:
- Firms & plumps - supports firmer, plumper-looking skin
- Smooths - for a smoother, more supple surface
- Collagen support - triple collagen complex with Matrixyl 3000 peptides
- Rich hydration - for a nourished, comfortable feel
What to expect: skin feels smoother and softer from the first use; in the Matrixyl® 3000 studies, firmer, smoother-looking results were measured at 2 months.
custom.how_to_use:
Use morning and/or evening as the last leave-on step, after your serums. Massage a pea-sized amount over slightly damp skin on the face and neck. In the morning, follow with SPF.
Pairs perfectly over the Matrixyl 3000 Firming Serum - the same Matrixyl 3000 peptide family as a serum-and-cream duo.
custom.clinical_research:
Matrixyl® 3000's two peptides raised collagen I by 256% in lab tests on skin cells.
This cream is built around Matrixyl® 3000, a pair of signal peptides from Sederma:
- Collagen I +256% in lab tests, nearly 4× the stronger peptide alone
- Fibronectin +147% and hyaluronic acid +92% in the same tests
- Give it 2 months: the length of the manufacturer's Matrixyl® 3000 studies
- Both peptides assessed safe in cosmetics by an independent expert panel
Lab: Sederma patent US 6,974,799 (human skin cells, 3 days). Safety: Cosmetic Ingredient Review 2018. Results describe the ingredient, not this product.

custom.faq_items.question: What does the Matrixyl 3000 Pro-Collagen Firming Cream do?
custom.faq_items.answer: A firming cream with collagen, elastin, the Matrixyl 3000 peptide complex, hyaluronic acid and squalane. It supports firmer, plumper and smoother-looking skin.

custom.faq_items.question: When and how do I use it?
custom.faq_items.answer: Morning and/or evening as your moisturiser step, after your serum. In the morning, finish with SPF 30+.

custom.faq_items.question: Can I pair it with the Matrixyl 3000 serum?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. Apply the Matrixyl 3000 Firming Serum first, then this cream to seal.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it vegan?
custom.faq_items.answer: No. The formula contains collagen and elastin of animal origin, so it is not suitable for a vegan routine. It is free from parabens and mineral oil.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for dry or mature skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. Its richer texture with squalane makes it well suited to normal-to-dry and mature-looking skin that needs firmness support.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Formulated without parabens, mineral oil or added synthetic fragrance. We recommend a patch test first.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 1. Cleanse
custom.how_to_steps.description: Wash with a gentle, pH-balanced cleanser and pat skin dry.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 2. Apply your serum
custom.how_to_steps.description: Apply your Skingenetix serum and allow it to absorb.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 3. Matrixyl Cream + SPF
custom.how_to_steps.description: Smooth on the Matrixyl 3000 Pro-Collagen Firming Cream, then finish with SPF 30+ in the morning.
